_about: Rocket parts for the builder (issue #6). One entry per part: its model in assets/parts/ (built by assets/source/parts.py), its real values and their sources (IDs of docs/sources.md). 'estimate' lists the fields that are our estimates (a stage mass split among its parts, or a price no one publishes); every other value is published. Masses in kg, thrust in kN, specific impulse in s, cost in millions of US dollars, lengths in m.

targets._about: Delta-v a launcher must give to put its payload on the way to each orbit, including gravity and drag losses. Earth to LEO is 9.3-10 km/s [S-delta-v]; we take 9.4. SSO adds 0.2 km/s for flying against the Earth's spin (our simplification). GEO means reaching the transfer orbit, LEO plus 2.3 km/s [S-delta-v]; the craft circularizes with its own engine. The Moon and L2 mean a translunar injection, LEO plus 3.2 km/s [S-delta-v].

failure_chance._about: Chance that a launch fails, for any rocket the player builds: our simplification, near the 2-5 % of the game's catalog launchers.

engine_merlin_x9.name: Nine kerosene engines
engine_merlin_x9.desc: Nine Merlin-type engines under a thrust section, the way the Falcon 9 first stage carries them: strong at sea level.

engine_merlin_vac.name: Vacuum kerosene engine
engine_merlin_vac.desc: A huge nozzle that only works in near vacuum: weak at liftoff, very efficient up high. For upper stages.

tank_37_long.name: Large first-stage tank
tank_37_long.desc: 3.7 m across and 38 m long, full of kerosene and liquid oxygen: the body of a Falcon 9-type first stage.

interstage_37.name: Large interstage
interstage_37.desc: Joins two stages and lets them go: everything below it falls away when the lower stage is empty. Grid fins included.

tank_37_short.name: Large upper-stage tank
tank_37_short.desc: The tank of a Falcon 9-type second stage: less fuel, but it burns where there is no air to push through.

fairing_52.name: Large fairing
fairing_52.desc: A 5.2 m shell that protects the craft through the air; it opens and drops once the rocket is above the atmosphere.

engine_small_x9.name: Nine small engines
engine_small_x9.desc: Nine Rutherford-type engines, the way the Electron first stage carries them.

engine_small_vac.name: Small vacuum engine
engine_small_vac.desc: One small engine with a longer nozzle, for the upper stage of a small rocket.

tank_12_long.name: Small first-stage tank
tank_12_long.desc: 1.2 m across, carbon composite: the body of an Electron-type first stage.

interstage_12.name: Small interstage
interstage_12.desc: Joins the two stages of a small rocket and lets the lower one go.

tank_12_short.name: Small upper-stage tank
tank_12_short.desc: The 2.4 m tank of an Electron-type second stage.

fairing_12.name: Small fairing
fairing_12.desc: A 1.2 m carbon shell for small craft.

booster_srb.name: Two solid boosters
booster_srb.desc: A pair of Space Shuttle-type solid boosters strapped to the first stage. Enormous push for two minutes, then they fall away. Values per booster.

presets._about: Ready rockets the player can start from, bottom to top.
